name: ocarina-of-time-nintendo-music-seven-songs-nov-5
lines:
أضافت نينتيندو (Nintendo) سبع
أغانٍ إضافية من موسيقى اللعبة

على خدمتها Nintendo Music
ضمن إصدار خاص للنسخة الجديدة

اللعبة نفسها تصدر اليوم على
جهاز Nintendo Switch 2
headline:
موسيقى Ocarina of Time
تزداد بسبع أغانٍ جديدة
label: رسمي
note: reel_check (reel-check.md not released). Story type MUSIC/release. Mohammad 5 Nov: screenshot of Nintendo of America's X post (about 20:20 ET 4 Nov: 'Hey! Listen... to 7 additional songs from The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, now on #NintendoMusic', special release card) and asked for the OoT intro music as the background; he sent the game's intro cinematic with its orchestral music as a Drive file (52.6 s, 1080p; used 21.0-38.7 s after the dark transition at 19 s). gate: primary = the Nintendo of America post (his screenshot); GoNintendo 'Nintendo Music soundtrack updates for Nov 4th' confirms 7 songs added 4 Nov; no track titles published, so none claimed; the 8 Sep special release was the orchestrated Title Theme (Miketendo, one track), the opening of the 8 Sep trailers. Not claimed: NSO-only, track names, which song this is. Hook: seven more Ocarina songs on Nintendo Music, over Link waking beside Navi. Footage: the intro cinematic from his file (official), 1080p source enlarged 1.78x, vertical full frame, no horizontal frame. Sound: the clip's own orchestral music, one contiguous stretch, speech none. picture: OoT intro cinematic Link asleep to Link standing (new; not the key art or earlier Ocarina footage). Names: Nintendo bracketed. Sensitive: none. genre: adventure.
